main.description: Cross-actor entity-graph keyword search across vertex_spatial / vertex_vessel / vertex_legal_entity / vertex_open_ports_port. Returns nodes with optional lat/lng so the client (App.svelte runUnifiedSearch) can drop pins. ADR-2605011500 §Phase-1.3.

query.description: Substring (case-insensitive) match against name / label; numeric ≥7 digits → MMSI/IMO/UN-LOCODE exact. Min length 2.

limit.description: Max nodes per source, total bounded ~4× this. Default 20, max 50.

nodes.description: Array of { id, label, title, lat?, lng?, sourceUrl?, types[], nsPrefix }.
